note: Source registry. confidence: high = primary text, official body, or a titled-player publication; medium = recognised educator or established site with named authorship; low = unsourced blog, forum, AI-written or anonymous page. Record low-confidence sources rather than discarding them, so a claim's provenance stays auditable.

ACCESS CAVEAT: the theme list was read from the publisher's product description, not from the book itself. It is corroborated independently by Wikipedia's citation of the companion Encyclopedia of Chess Middlegames, whose category list overlaps and extends it. Treat the LIST as high confidence and any wording attributed to the book as unverified.
